name: Elfi Masonry – Filterable Portfolio & Masonry Gallery Addon for Elementor
author: Sharabindu

sections.description:
ELFI Masonry is a feature-rich Elementor Masonry Gallery & Filterable Portfolio Addon designed for showcasing portfolios, products, blog posts, or any custom post type. It helps you create dynamic, category-based filters and visually appealing image galleries with full Elementor styling options.

Try the Demo | Premium version | Documents | Backend Demo

Preview ElFI Masonry Addon For Elementor

The addon includes:

  • Filter Masonry Widget (Post-based masonry with category filter)
  • Gallery Masonry Widget (Custom image gallery masonry)

Both widgets are fully responsive, SEO-friendly, and work with any Elementor-compatible theme.

Filter Masonry Widget

The Filter Masonry widget lets you create filterable masonry layouts based on WordPress post types. Categories automatically become filter buttons, allowing users to sort items instantly.

Features of Filter Masonry

Post Type Based Showcase

Create category-based showcases for:
– Products (WooCommerce)
– Blog Posts
– Portfolio items
– Custom post types

Two Sorting Methods

  1. Category Sorting
    Displays category-specific items with filter buttons.

  2. Post Type Sorting
    Displays all items under the selected post type without a filter bar.

Category Filter Support

When users click a category button, only items from that category are displayed. Ideal for creating:
– Product filters
– Portfolio filters
– Blog post filters
– Service filters

Gallery Masonry Widget

The Gallery Masonry widget allows you to create a beautiful custom image masonry gallery without needing posts or categories. All items are added directly from the Elementor editor.

Features of Gallery Masonry

Add Unlimited Items

Add as many gallery items as needed. Each item can include:
– Image
– Title / Caption
– Link
– Popup content

Custom Title and Images

Each gallery item can have a custom:
– Image
– Text/Title
– URL
– Popup content

Item Link Support

Hovering over each item reveals a link icon that opens a custom URL.

Popup Content Options

Each item can display pop-up elements such as:
– Popup Image
– Popup Video (YouTube/Vimeo)
– Popup Shortcode
– Popup HTML
– Popup Map Embed
– Popup content with image gallery

Preview & Buy Links

Perfect for product showcases. Add:
– Preview button
– Buy Now button
– Any custom link

Other Features

  • Portfolio Filter
  • Post Filter
  • Product Filter
  • Custom Post Type Support
  • Change permalink slug for “elfi-masonry-addon”
  • Fully responsive layout
  • Popup image viewer
  • 2, 3, and 4-column layouts
  • Read More button option
  • Cross-browser compatibility
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Well documented

Premium Features

The premium version includes even more advanced controls:

  • Freestyle masonry with 10+ premium styles
  • Gallery Masonry with 10 extra professional layouts
  • Custom post type full support
  • 14+ layout animations
  • Popup video support (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.)
  • Popup shortcode support
  • Popup raw HTML support
  • Popup embed (map, iframe, code)
  • Custom popup icons
  • Popup content with image gallery
  • AJAX-based infinite scroll pagination
  • 12+ filter button styles
  • More customization options and templates

Privacy

ELFI Masonry does not collect, store, or transmit any user data.
It does not connect to any external service.
This is an addon built exclusively for the Elementor Page Builder.

Feedback

We welcome your suggestions and feedback.
If you enjoy using ELFI Masonry, please leave a positive review and share your experience.

And many more things are waiting for you to discover

sections.installation:
1. Go to the Plugins menu in your WordPress dashboard and click Add New.
  2. In the search bar, type “Elfi Masonry Filter”.
  3. Click Install Now next to the plugin name.
  4. Once installed, click Activate to enable the plugin on your site.

Alternatively:

  • Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress plugin directory.
  • Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  • Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  • Activate the plugin after installation.
sections.faq:
What is the Elfi Masonry Addon?

Elfi Masonry Addon is a WordPress plugin that allows you to create responsive, filterable masonry grid galleries easily. It’s designed for photo galleries, portfolios, and stylish content grids.

Is Elfi Masonry Addon mobile-friendly?

Yes! The plugin is fully responsive and works beautifully across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I add filters to my masonry gallery?

Absolutely. Elfi Masonry Addon lets you add category-based filters so visitors can sort and view images by category in real-time.

Can I use multiple masonry galleries on one website?

A. Yes, you can create and display multiple masonry galleries on the same website without conflicts.

Is the plugin compatible with any WordPress theme?

Yes — Elfi Masonry Addon is designed to work with any well-coded WordPress theme.

Will Elfi Masonry Addon work only with Elementor Page Builder?

Yes, it is an Elementor addon plugin, and it will work only on the Elementor Free and Elementor Pro versions.

Does it work along with other Elementor Addons?

Yes, of course. You can use it very well with other Elementor addons or extensions
